Washington, DC, November 6, 2025 – Two in three Latinos feel it is a bad time to be Latino or Hispanic in America, according to a new Axios/Ipsos poll conducted in partnership with Noticias Telemundo. This represents a sharp increase in unease and uncertainty about their place in society over the last year. The poll, conducted among over 1,100 Latino/Hispanic Americans, also finds fewer Latinos feel like they can live the “American Dream” compared to the past few years.
